items.title: Bank of America’s Unrealized Bond Losses Could Top $90 Billion on Surging Yields
items.summary: The paper losses on a large Bank of America bond portfolio could have widened by more than $10 billion to over $90 billion in the current quarter, thanks to the fixed-income market’s blistering selloff.  Bank of America  $506 billion portfolio of low-rate bonds, mostly U.S. agency mortgage securities, has been a sore spot for shareholders.  Bank of America declined to comment Thursday.
